hypothesis: With dimensions and row degrees fixed, uniform minus banded root cycles equals 25 times the difference in structural output entries for the full-row, one-PE implementation.
calibration: New registered 64x64 case: 576 products in both inputs; output counts 320 and 549; cycle difference 5725. The earlier 16x16 follow-up also suggested 25, but used a different data layout and ELF.
acceptance: Use first unchanged broadcast-mode sessions and retain all residuals or missing-case status. This predicts a within-build contrast, not an absolute latency or universal store cost.
evidence_status: No N=256 registered case has produced a timing checkpoint at registration.
